relations.subject: William Henry Sleeman
relations.role: infantry cadet, Ensign, Lieutenant, Captain, Major, Lieutentant-Colonel, Colonel, Major-General
relations.evidence: In 1809 joined the Bengal Army as infantry cadet, was immediately sent to India. From 1810 Ensign, 1814 Lieutenant... 1853 Colonel, 1854 Major-General. Since 1854 ill, retired

relations.subject: William Henry Sleeman
relations.role: Assistant to Adjutant-General for the Sagar and Nerbudda Territories
relations.evidence: Joined E.I.C. political service and was Assistant to Adjutant-General for the Sagar and Nerbudda Territories, from 1820, 1822 for Narsinghpur district.

relations.subject: William Henry Sleeman
relations.evidence: In 1825-35 Magistrate and District Officer in the future Central Provinces (1828 Jubbulpore, 1831 Sagar).

relations.subject: William Henry Sleeman
relations.object: Operations for the suppression of Thagi
relations.evidence: General Superintendent of the Operations for the suppression of Thagi (“Thuggee”) from 1835 (assisted from 1829), and also of Dakaiti (Dacoits), from 1839.
